title: Fix orbit deterministic capture ordering
objective: Fix deterministic orbit capture setup order after Inspector finding
instructions: Inspector found a high-severity issue in the current orbit render flicker fix: examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py configures bAlwaysPersistRenderingState before component.Initialize(), but cpp/unreal_plugins/SpUnrealTypes/Source/SpUnrealTypes/SpSceneCaptureComponent2D.cpp Initialize() unconditionally sets bAlwaysPersistRenderingState=true. Move deterministic capture configuration so it is applied after Initialize()/initialize_sp_funcs where needed, preserve camera-cut behavior, update tests to cover the ordering, and keep docs accurate if wording changes.
constraints: Do not commit. Do not revert unrelated dirty worktree changes. Keep changes scoped to orbit render determinism and tests/docs if necessary.
expected_outputs: Builder ResultPacket with changed files, validation commands/results, and any live-render caveats.
definition_of_done: scene_off_flashlight_on render setup disables scene light direct/indirect contribution, deterministic capture config survives component initialization, tests or targeted smoke checks cover the order, and no commit is made.
